description: This Java source file contains integration tests for external business events in the Apache Fineract project. It includes various test cases for verifying external event triggers like loan balance changes, rescheduling, charge adjustments, transaction reversals, and related business events. It also manages setup and teardown for external event configurations and performs detailed assertions on the event payloads to ensure correct event generation and data consistency.

classes.name: ExternalBusinessEventTest
classes.description: A JUnit 5 test class for testing external business events in the Fineract system, extending BaseLoanIntegrationTest, containing multiple test cases for various event scenarios.

methods.name: beforeAll
methods.description: Initial setup method executed once before all tests to initialize REST assured, create clients, loan product, and set business steps.

methods.name: testExternalBusinessEventLoanBalanceChangedBusinessEventOnMultiDisbursedInterestBearingLoanForRepaymentAndOverpaymentAndReverseRepaymentAndFullRepayment
methods.description: Test case verifying external events triggered by loan balance changes, repayments, overpayments, reversals, and checks on event payload correctness.

methods.name: verifyLoanChargeAdjustmentPostBusinessEvent01
methods.description: Verifies that a loan charge adjustment posts the correct external event with a populated 'loanChargePaidByList' when adjustment is for the full charge.

methods.name: verifyLoanChargeAdjustmentPostBusinessEvent02
methods.description: Verifies 'loanChargePaidByList' is correctly populated during partial charge adjustments and that over-amount adjustments are rejected.

methods.name: verifyLoanChargeAdjustmentPostBusinessEvent03
methods.description: Checks that repayment events during partial charges appropriately populate 'loanChargePaidByList', and adjustments beyond full charge are rejected.

methods.name: verifyLoanChargeAdjustmentPostBusinessEvent04
methods.description: Tests charge adjustment event for loans without interest recalculation, verifying correct population of 'loanChargePaidByList'.

methods.name: verifyLoanChargeAdjustmentPostBusinessEvent05
methods.description: Tests partial charge adjustment with interest recalculation disabled, and verifies proper rejection on over-adjustment.

methods.name: verifyLoanChargeAdjustmentPostBusinessEvent06
methods.description: Validates charge adjustments with interest recalculation disabled, ensuring appropriate event payloads.

methods.name: verifyLoanChargeAdjustmentPostBusinessEvent07
methods.description: Tests charge adjustment on loans without interest, ensuring correct 'loanChargePaidByList' population.

methods.name: verifyLoanChargeAdjustmentPostBusinessEvent08
methods.description: Verifies partial charge adjustment behavior on loans with no interest, including rejection on over-adjustment.

methods.name: verifyLoanChargeAdjustmentPostBusinessEvent09
methods.description: Checks that repayment events pay the charge and also tests partial charge adjustments and rejections post-interest recalculation.

methods.name: testInterestBearingProgressiveInterestRecalculationReopenDueReverseRepayment
methods.description: Simulates an interest-bearing progressive loan with backdated disbursement and partial repayment, testing accruals, overpayment, reversals, and transaction reversal events.

methods.name: verifyInterestRefundPostBusinessEventCreatedForMerchantIssuedRefundWithInterestRefund
methods.description: Tests that interest refund post business events are created correctly during merchant-issued refunds.

methods.name: testExternalBusinessEventLoanRescheduledDueAdjustScheduleBusinessEventInterestChange
methods.description: Verifies that rescheduling loans with interest rate change correctly triggers external events.

methods.name: testProgressiveLoanReverseReplayChargeOffEvents
methods.description: Ensures that reverse and replay of charge-off events produce correct external events and payloads.

methods.name: verifyLoanApplicationModifiedBusinessEvent01
methods.description: Checks that modifying a loan application results in appropriate external event with updated principal.

methods.name: verifyLoanWithdrawnByApplicantBusinessEvent01
methods.description: Tests that withdrawing a loan application by an applicant triggers the corresponding external event.

methods.name: ExternalIdGenerationTest
methods.description: Nested class containing tests related to external ID generation, enabling/disabling configuration, and testing event generation with external IDs.
